## Why this course matters

This course develops the computational mindset required for modern statistical research. Students work with methods that are central to simulation-based inference, latent variable models, high-dimensional data analysis, and reproducible scientific computation.

## Learning path

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Computational foundations
Monte Carlo methods, simulation design, numerical integration and algorithmic reasoning.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Statistical learning tools
EM, bootstrap, importance sampling, optimization, and model-based inference.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Research practice
Independent project design, data analysis, reproducibility, and professional communication.
:::
:::
